credits.title: Boonie Bears: The Hidden Protector
credits.overview: After gaining magical powers from Nian, the legendary Year Monster, our heroes are transported to a magical realm to stop a world-ending crisis. Briar deals with losing his 'big brother' status after the others gain powers, leading him to stumble into a plot that threatens both the human and immortal worlds.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Future Reborn
credits.overview: Bramble, Briar, and Vick unexpectedly follow a time traveller 100 years in the future, where they find Earth beset by environmental catastrophe, with humanity barely able to survive.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Time Twist
credits.overview: When Vick gets a chance to start his life again as a logger, he must save his friends by embarking on an adventure through time and space.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Guardian Code
credits.overview: Briar and Bramble, who lost their mother Barbara when they were cubs, are thrown into danger when escorting a scientist, which may lead them to a family reunion.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Back to Earth
credits.overview: When an unknown object from space lands on Earth, Bramble gains new abilities and an extraterrestrial sidekick.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: The Wild Life
credits.overview: Bear brothers Briar and Bramble set off on an adventure with their human friend Vick to Wild Land, an amusement park where humans can turn into animals using a gene-technology bracelet.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Blast into the Past
credits.overview: Boonie bears and bareheaded Qiang blast into primitive times and experience a period of exciting and breathtaking time in a primitive tribe.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: The Big Shrink
credits.overview: Briar and Bramble, two bear brothers who constantly annoy Vick, are about to have a rude awakening. Vick goes to meet them to make them disappear and remove them from his life. credits.title: Fantastica: A Boonie Bears Adventure
credits.overview: Boonie bears and Bald Qiang work together with secret primitive girl to smash a conspiracy to destroy old-growth forest.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: The Big Top Secret
credits.overview: Frustrated with his pals, Briar joins a traveling circus, where new friends and fame keep the homesickness away... for a while.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: A Mystical Winter
credits.overview: A strange yet familiar creature turns up, prompting a flooding of Bramble Bear's youthful memories. The forest descends into turmoil when a group of strangers arrive, on the hunt for the mysterious creature.

credits.title: One Hundred Thousand Bad Jokes
credits.overview: Chinese animated fantasy comedy based on classic stories.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Robo-Rumble
credits.overview: With Spring Festival just around the corner, logger Vick learns that he has just been laid off for the holiday season. Trying to get another job, he finally gets employed as a Forest Ranger. credits.title: Boonie Bears: To the Rescue
credits.overview: The lives of the bear bothers change dramatically when a little girl finds herself in the forest and they must fight bad guys to bring her to safety.

credits.title: Boonie Bears: Homeward Journey
credits.overview: Briar Bear, Bramble Bear & friends enjoy life in the woods when Logger Vick begins chopping down trees to get money to go home for the holidays. As Logger Vick is homesick, they hatch a plan to get Vick home in time for the holidays.
